refused_program.intent: Initialise the nested repository declared at submodule_path and check it out at the upstream-consistent pinned commit.

postconditions.description: the submodule is initialized and checked out at HEAD's gitlink commit
postconditions.name: submodule_initialised_at_head
postconditions.probe:
line=$(git submodule status -- "{submodule_path}") &&
head_pin=$(git rev-parse "HEAD:{submodule_path}") &&
test -n "$line" &&
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -c1)" = " " &&
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -c2-41)" = "$head_pin"

postconditions.description: every nested submodule under the path is initialized at its recorded commit
postconditions.name: recursive_submodules_initialised
postconditions.probe:
out=$(git submodule status --recursive -- "{submodule_path}") &&
test -n "$out" &&
! printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qv '^ '

postconditions.description: initialising the submodule left the parent worktree clean
postconditions.name: worktree_still_clean

preconditions.description: HEAD records a gitlink at the submodule path
preconditions.name: gitlink_in_head

preconditions.description: the gitlink in HEAD equals the one on the upstream branch
preconditions.name: submodule_pin_matches_upstream
preconditions.probe:
head_pin=$(git rev-parse "HEAD:{submodule_path}") &&
up_pin=$(git rev-parse "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:{submodule_path}" 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse "@{upstream}:{submodule_path}") &&
test -n "$head_pin" &&
test -n "$up_pin" &&
test "$head_pin" = "$up_pin"
